title: Hollerith machines at work on the 1890 census
alt: An engraving: a woman seated at a Hollerith machine reads a sheet while she feeds cards into a press; above her a cabinet of round dials counts, stacks of cards stand beside her, and more clerks work behind.
author: Artist not credited.
